text:
ITEM 1 | Square white plate about 26 cm across used as scale; left side holds a pile of diced pale potato-like cubes, roughly 1.5-2.5 cm pieces, pale cream with golden-brown edges and dry, slightly crisp surfaces, scattered with small green herb flecks; covers about 35% of plate area, height about 1.5-2 cm | 180
ITEM 2 | Small dark brown mushroom pieces, about 1-2 cm, glossy and moist-looking, mixed among the diced pale cubes on the left side of the plate | 35
ITEM 3 | Chunks of soft, pale whitish-cream pieces with translucent edges, about 1.5-2 cm, mixed with the potato cubes, slightly glossy, possibly onion-like layers, lying in a loose pile | 25
ITEM 4 | Small pieces of bright red-orange soft vegetable, about 2 cm, moist and slightly glossy, sitting at the center between the potato pile and the right item | 15
ITEM 5 | Two rectangular slabs of baked dish on the right side, roughly 5-6 cm long by 3-4 cm wide, golden-orange to tan top with darker speckled patches, slightly crusty and browned at edges, layered and firm, about 2-3 cm tall, sitting over a pale base | 110
ITEM 6 | Smaller pale golden-tan piece about 3 cm by 2 cm, firm and lightly browned with a slightly dry surface, placed beside the larger slabs on the far right edge of the plate | 30
ITEM 7 | Dark grey-brown mushroom slices and pieces about 1-2 cm, glossy and moist, sitting against the right slab and between the vegetables | 25
